title: JournalEvent
description:
One row of the Pramana append-only journal, widened for AI-DLC phase 1. This is `audit-event.schema.json` plus the four fields the provenance artifact needs to assemble itself: `tokens`, `cost_usd`, `injected_units`, and `phase`. It is a separate schema rather than an edit to `audit-event` because that shape is a released cross-product contract and the additive-only rule applies to it too.

APPEND-ONLY IS ENFORCED IN THE DATABASE, not by convention: `pramana_events` carries SQLite triggers that reject UPDATE and DELETE. A trigger cannot be bypassed by a force-push, which is why a git-backed journal was rejected in favour of it.

HASH CHAIN. `prev_hash`/`entry_hash` make an offline edit of the SQLite file detectable. They are not self-sufficient — anyone who can edit the file can recompute the chain forward and restore self-consistency — so the chain head is anchored in the provenance artifact, which is committed to the user's git and pushed to their remote. See provenance.schema.json `pramana.chain_head`.

session_id.description: Scopes the entry to a single user/agent session.

event.description: Event name. Open-ended; products define their own vocabulary.

trace_id.description: Correlates the entry with its task. Required on every event without exception.

task_id.description: Prajna task UUID, null when not task-scoped.

repo_id.description: Repo UUID, null when not repo-scoped.

phase.description: Which SDLC phase produced the event. Free-form so a user-defined agent is not forced into the five kinds; conventionally one of `intent`, `plan`, `code`, `build`, `review`, `deploy`, `monitor`. Null for platform events belonging to no phase.

tokens.description: Token accounting for a model turn. Null on every event that is not a model turn.

cost_usd.description: Estimated USD for this event. An ESTIMATE from a local price table, never a billed amount — the provider's invoice is authoritative and the artifact says so.

injected_units.description: The exact set of Smriti unit addresses injected into this turn's prompt, in injection order. This is what makes the run reconstructable: given a task id, recover exactly what the model was told.

prev_hash.description: `entry_hash` of the preceding row. Null on the first row of the chain only.

entry_hash.description: sha256(audit_id || prev_hash || canonical_json(row)), where canonical_json excludes `prev_hash` and `entry_hash` themselves and serialises with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace.
